name: Naltrexone
metabolism: Extensive first-pass and extrahepatic metabolism produces 6-beta-naltrexol and conjugated metabolites. Elimination is mainly renal, with very little unchanged naltrexone in urine.
summary: Naltrexone is an opioid antagonist used primarily to manage opioid and alcohol use disorders by reducing cravings and the rewarding effects of substance use. It is taken orally or by intramuscular injection.
